title: tigridia purruchucana subsp. simplex
intro: Tigridia purruchucana subsp. simplex, commonly known as the yellow gladiolus, is a species of flowering plant that belongs to the family Iridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Tigridia purruchucana subsp. simplex include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, making it useful for wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
